dataqual.logic: These data were generated using DSAS, an automated software program which does not perform checks for fidelity of the input features. Any testing on these data should be carried out by end-users to ensure fidelity of relationships.
dataqual.complete: This dataset contains all the transects automatically generated by the DSAS software application.

procstep.procdesc: Transect Features Generated using DSAS v4.3. Parameters Used: baseline layer=Baselines, baseline group field=NULL, transect spacing=1 meters, transect length=20 meters, cast direction=AUTO-DETECT, baseline location=on/off shore, cast method=simple, smoothing distance=5 meters, flip baselines=not selected. For additional details on these parameters, please see the DSAS help file distributed with the DSAS software, or visit the USGS website at: http://pubs.usgs.gov/of/2008/1278/ .

Rate Calculations Performed. Parameters Used: shoreline layer=ACERShorelines, shoreline date field=Date_, shoreline uncertainty field name=Uncertaint, the default accuracy=1 meters, shoreline intersection parameters=nearest, stats calculations=[Net Shoreline Movement (NSM)], shoreline threshold=none, confidence interval=95%, Output rate table name=Transects_rates_20181024_135057.

attr.attrdef: Assigned by DSAS to to record the azimuth of the transect measure in degrees clockwise from North.
attr.attrdefs: U.S. Geological Survey, Woods Hole Science Center

attr.attrdef: Unique identification number of the baseline segment. If BaselineID=0 no transects will be generated. Used by DSAS to determine transect ordering alongshore if multiple baseline segments exist.
attr.attrdefs: U.S. Geological Survey, Woods Hole Science Center

attr.attrdef: Assigned by DSAS based on user input. Groups are assigned using the following logic: if a user selects a group field as an input parameter (an attribute field in the user-specified baseline feature class), DSAS will populate the transect feature class with the corresponding group ID value of the baseline segment from which the transect is cast; if user does not select a baseline group field as an input parameter, then DSAS assigns a value of zero. The group field is used to segregate large areas into discrete sections when computing advanced change statistics that utilize spatial autocorrelation. Users may change group field values after the transects are automatically generated and before statistics are computed.
attr.attrdefs: U.S. Geological Survey, Woods Hole Science Center

attr.attrdef: Assigned by DSAS based on ordering of transects along the baseline. Used to allow user to sort transect data along the baseline from baseline start to baseline end.
